title: Facility Handbook Extract: Unit Transfers and Agreement Endings under a Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan
content:
When the agreement covered by a Bluegate Prepaid Rent Plan is transferred to another unit, or ends by lien sale or tow, each plan settles what becomes of the plan and of its unused credit. The six plans settle these points identically.

| Plan | A unit transfer keeps the plan on the agreement | Transfer to a unit with a different rent is settled by | Unused credit when the agreement ends by lien sale or tow |
|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 3-Month Plan | Yes | Billing or crediting the difference monthly | Applied to the agreement's balance |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 6-Month Plan | Yes | Billing or crediting the difference monthly | Applied to the agreement's balance |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 9-Month Plan | Yes | Billing or crediting the difference monthly | Applied to the agreement's balance |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 12-Month Plan | Yes | Billing or crediting the difference monthly | Applied to the agreement's balance |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 18-Month Plan | Yes | Billing or crediting the difference monthly | Applied to the agreement's balance |
| Bluegate Prepaid Rent 24-Month Plan | Yes | Billing or crediting the difference monthly | Applied to the agreement's balance |

## Points for facility staff

- **Transfer.** A transfer of the covered agreement to another unit does not end the plan; the plan stays on the agreement. Where the new unit's rent differs from the old one, the rent difference is billed (if the new rent is higher) or credited (if it is lower) month by month.
- **Lien sale or tow.** When the covered agreement ends by lien sale or tow, the plan's unused prepaid credit goes to the balance owed on that agreement.

Hypothetical illustration: a tenant on a 9-month plan transfers from a unit at a monthly rent of $120.00 to a unit at $150.00 during the term. The plan stays on the agreement, and the $30.00 difference in rent is billed each month.
